review.scope: Maintainer review of the exact public npm archive: identity, version, SHA512, SHA1, byte length, public entry points, browser UI and dependency declarations, with byte equality against the locally accepted release archive. Final source commit passed make check, make build and forty-package packed installation on macOS ARM64 and Linux ARM64 Ubuntu Docker with real Linux sandbox checks. Six native targets passed strict architecture, digest and assembly checks; cross-compilation does not establish runtime acceptance on every target. Linux x64 native Debian source gate acceptance is a historical user handoff at 59cd8eb0ff4a3d4bdf92689c78417a229f2c2c81 under the previous package scope; its remote logs were unavailable for this local review. No final Linux x64 execution is claimed. Supported catalog targets are macOS ARM64 and Linux x64 by the maintainer's accepted release scope. Source is private; commit binding is maintainer supplied. GitHub Actions evidence and npm provenance are absent. Windows runtime acceptance, other architectures, exhaustive dependency security audits and paid provider calls are outside this review. Compatibility acceptance with the public npm global installation of @eum-agent/cli@1.0.1 and @eum-agent/extension-catalog@1.0.1 from source commit ce2a5a77d4ec93e47387976131519a9f4ee3759f passed on macOS ARM64 using staged committed catalog JSON at 27e51964a31821036e9f70314cafe16dd0e47cb9: all fourteen defaults installed and all thirty-six plugins activated. Further compatibility acceptance passed on macOS ARM64 with a global npm installation of the frozen local @eum-agent/cli@1.0.2 archive from source commit 7642496bc9f6e3f38a0ba9f1d5324bdf8f857731 (SHA512 sha512-X+SLXbtNr1QhqBfuSlPzCJbf2hE6ISEU7mZSZz4zVhy+Hg7RDs8y9O9if+cO0+4vTHGM3YTTJZAQ/2Qb0LYGQQ==; SHA1 e5b3ade8ffcd331297c4cf8d2763d18e5efef0a8), public npm dependencies including @eum-agent/extension-catalog@1.0.1, and all fourteen public default extension archives, using staged committed catalog JSON at 218820a220c13cf8c927f368bc35c047f4152e78: exactly twenty-two built-ins and fourteen defaults were installed, all thirty-six plugins activated, authenticated model/Agent/workspace/session RPCs passed, and instance-bound shutdown observed actual child close and consumed output EOF. The same installed CLI archive passed native launchd fresh start, recovery with a missing manual plist while running, and recovery with a missing manual plist while loaded idle, without enabling automatic startup; cleanup observed actual HTTP termination and native job absence and removed the fixture. The final CLI source commit passed the complete make check gate (twenty-one steps), make build and forty-package packed installation. This compatibility acceptance used a frozen local CLI archive and staged catalog JSON; it establishes neither public CLI 1.0.2 availability nor live GitHub catalog acceptance or new Linux runtime acceptance.
